name: Full Feature SDLC Lifecycle
description: End-to-end SDLC pipeline: Architecture Spec -> Implementation -> QA Test Generation -> Security Audit -> PR Review.

stages.name: Architecture & Spec
stages.description: Architect writes technical design document and API contract.

stages.name: Code Implementation
stages.description: Engineer writes source code based on architecture specifications.

stages.name: Unit & Integration Tests
stages.description: QA Synthesizer generates unit tests and runs verification suites.

stages.name: Security Audit
stages.description: SecOps scans code for vulnerabilities, OWASP issues, and secrets.

stages.name: Final PR Review
stages.description: Reviewer signs off with release approval or feedback.

name: Vulnerability Triage & Auto-Patch
description: Rapid triage pipeline: SecOps discovers flaw -> Engineer authors patch -> QA verifies fix with regression tests.

stages.name: Automated Patch Authoring
stages.description: Engineer generates surgical patch without breaking API.

stages.name: Regression Verification
stages.description: QA executes test suite to guarantee regression-free patch.
